# Water Diplomacy Books

> Catalog of books on water diplomacy at https://waterdiplomacybooks.com/
> Open-access titles are featured first. v1 is books only (no chapters/articles index).

## Open access (featured)

- [Routledge Handbook of Water Diplomacy](https://waterdiplomacyhandbook.com/) (Islam, Smith, Klimes & Salzberg, eds., Routledge 2026) — companion site, not cloned here. DOI: https://doi.org/10.4324/9781003178439
- [Interdisciplinary Collaboration for Water Diplomacy](https://waterdiplomacybooks.com/books/2019-interdisciplinary-collaboration/) (Islam & Smith, eds., Routledge 2019). DOI: https://doi.org/10.4324/9780429428760
- [Water Diplomacy](https://waterdiplomacybooks.com/books/2012-water-diplomacy/) (Islam & Susskind, Routledge 2012). DOI: https://doi.org/10.4324/9780203083659

Chapter cards for the 2012 and 2019 titles open the live Taylor & Francis chapter page. This site does not host PDFs.

- [Timeline](https://waterdiplomacybooks.com/timeline/): all catalogued titles by publication year
